result.summary: The full and compact table-free proofs preserve all originally allowed cycles, exhaust nine good-boundary transition families and guarantee at least two safe common edges in every family. Six families follow from a general cycle-deletion/inclusion-exclusion bound, with rigorous EM and MA common-omission corrections; the other three use the previously selected square/hexagon supports. The finite independent readback matches all stated counts and literal profiles.
